meta.title: Refreshing last-PO prices is allowed only when switched on, for live events with PR-linked lines
gaps: The vocabulary has no gate for allow_lpo_update or an operation to switch it off or on.
No setup recipe creates a live event with two PR-linked lines, one already in a selected award.
No operation refreshes last-PO data or exposes its in-progress status, line-level refresh results, or request queueing.
No operation or assertion vocabulary represents refusal for a draft event or an event with no PR-linked line.
